thread:
Amira (PM): Quick Q2 OKR milestone sync — short check: what shipped, what slipped, owners, and CR pings. TL;DR: prefix cache shipped to 80% prod, runtime-v2 rollout slipped. Please drop short status.
Carlos (Eng): Prefix caching rolled to 80% prod this morning. Metrics look good (99.95% p95 token latency). PR: https://git.redwood/infra/prefix-cache/pull/847 :thumbsup:
Priya (Eng): runtime-v2 path hit a CUDA kernel mismatch during quantized runs. Repro on local GPU. Owner: @Priya. ETA is ~3 business days if driver patch lands.
Sam (Eng Mgr): Thanks. I'm reallocating one engineer to help Priya tomorrow. @Carlos can you take the fix if it's infra-adjacent?
Carlos (Eng): Can do a quick look. CR ping to @Priya @Sam — please review PRs 847 and 851 when you can.
Priya (Eng): I can review 847 tonight. 851 needs a repro in CI (failing on seq_len > 2048). Assigning to @Carlos for CI fix.
Jules (SRE): Heads up — infra driver update window available Wed 03:00–05:00 UTC. Driver patch will require node reboots. Suggest canary on dedicated nodes first.
Amira (PM): Plan: (1) CRs finished by EOD Thu, (2) Jules schedules canary Wed night, (3) Priya pushes patched kernels, (4) I'll update the OKR doc and notify execs. Agree? :eyes:
Anya (Design): No UI changes required. Please add telemetry event: `runtime_v2_canary_start` and `runtime_v2_canary_result` so analytics can track.
deploy-bot: deploy/infra-driver started canary on infra-dedicated-1 at 2026-03-18T03:12:10Z. (canary id c-20260318-1)
Carlos (Eng): Quick checklist for owners (copying into OKR doc):
- Shipped: prefix-cache (owner Carlos) :white_check_mark:
- Slipped: runtime-v2 general availability (owner Priya) :warning:
- Blocker: driver compat + seq_len CI (owner Jules/Carlos)
- Next action: CR reviews, driver canary, CI repro fix
Priya (Eng): Pushing a small repro fix to CI now, will ping when green. If green, I'll open a hotfix PR for the kernel shim.
Sam (Eng Mgr): I'll block time 2pm local to pair on the PR reviews. If we clear reviews, we can aim for canary on Thu instead of Fri.
Amira (PM): Thanks everyone. I'll update the OKR board with new ETA and add a note: "runtime-v2 GA delayed by driver validation; mitigation: canary + extra reviewer". Will follow up with a short async update after canary.
Carlos (Eng): CR reminders sent to @Priya and @Sam. :mailbox_with_mail:
Priya (Eng): ACK, starting review pass now. :hammer_and_wrench:
Jules (SRE): Once canary completes I'll post logs and perf diffs here. If anything spikes we'll rollback and notify.
Amira (PM): Great — keep updates short in this thread. If anything slips again, ping me and I'll escalate. :rocket:
